rules.prebreak_direction: first Asia high/low side crossed between 09:00 and start time
rules.prebroken_entry_raw: close of start-time 1m candle; exits checked from next minute
rules.prebroken_entry_exec: next 1m candle executable open (ask for long, bid for short)
rules.fresh_entry_raw: Asia boundary; exits checked from next minute
rules.fresh_entry_exec: Asia boundary +/- half conservative open/close spread; exits checked from next minute
rules.eod: if neither TP nor SL hits by local day end, close/mark at final executable close
